faq.a: It is the south half of the city-proper side of Chilliwack — the downtown-side residential area working to Yale Road, Nowell Street, Spadina Avenue, Chilliwack Central Road and Young Road north of Highway 1; it is a board/search grouping, and no board-published boundary for it exists.

faq.q: Which schools serve Chilliwack Proper South?
faq.a: SD33 catchments are address-based. The live page names Robertson Elementary (46106 Southlands Cres), McCammon Elementary (9601 Hamilton St), Bernard Elementary (45465 Bernard Ave), Chilliwack Middle School (46354 Yale Rd) and Chilliwack Secondary (46363 Yale Rd), with names and addresses confirmed against the BC Ministry K-12 file; run any specific address in SD33's School Locator to confirm its catchment.

faq.q: Can a house here have a suite or a coach house?
faq.a: One accessory dwelling unit per lot where the zone permits it — a secondary suite (capped at the lesser of 90 m² and 40% of the building's habitable floor space), a coach house, or a garden suite (capped at 100 m²) — under Zoning Bylaw 2020, No. 5000, ss. 2 and 4.06, with SSMUH (Bylaw No. 5395, adopted June 18, 2024) allowing 3 to 4 units on eligible parcels inside the urban growth boundary.

faq.q: When are Chilliwack property taxes due, and what is the penalty?
faq.a: Notices are mailed at the end of May and taxes are due the first working day after July 1 each year; for 2026, a 5% penalty applies to taxes outstanding after July 2, 2026 and an additional 5% to taxes outstanding after August 4, 2026.
